items.original_text: Estimated time: 255 to 635 days. Estimated government cost: $8,926 to $39,980. Notes: This timeline and cost range is for the approvals in the entitlement path when they are granted: Conditional Use Authorization (120–300 days, $3,100–$15,000), Place of Entertainment permit (45–120 days, $2,708–$3,800), health permit to operate (14–45 days, $470–$1,000), and building permit with change of use (14–120 days, $800–$15,000). The timeline assumes the CUA is filed after the SUD license-transfer question is settled in writing, the ABC Type 42 application or transfer is filed after the CUA is approved and the 30-day appeal period has run, the POE permit is filed in parallel with or after the ABC application, and the building permit and health permit are filed after the CUA and POE approvals are in hand. The 255–635 day range is measured from filing the CUA to obtaining the health permit and building permit final sign-off, assuming all approvals are granted. It does not include the time to identify and escrow a Type 42 license from another bar in the SUD (if a transfer is required), which can add 2–6 months before the CUA is filed. The cost range includes only city and Entertainment Commission fees, not the ABC license fee ($1,000–$1,600), the cost of purchasing a Type 42 license on the open market (if required, typically $5,000–$50,000+ depending on availability), or the cost of construction, architectural plans, or brokers. State and federal registrations (entity formation $70–$150, seller's permit $0, EIN $0, food safety certifications ~$100–$250, RBS training ~$3–$30 per person, workers' comp insurance premiums) and music licenses ($600–$5,000 per year for ASCAP and BMI) are not included. The timeline assumes no appeals, no Discretionary Review, no protests at the ABC or Entertainment Commission hearings, and no failed inspections. If the concept is formula retail (chain with 11+ locations), add the formula-retail review to the CUA hearing. If the floor area is 3,001 sq ft or more, the use-size trigger is already part of the CUA. The Building Code change-of-occupancy question is not settled, so the building permit timeline may be longer if a change of occupancy is required.

outcomes.original: Estimated time: 255 to 635 days. Estimated government cost: $8,926 to $39,980. Notes: This timeline and cost range is for the approvals in the entitlement path when they are granted: Conditional Use Authorization (120–300 days, $3,100–$15,000), Place of Entertainment permit (45–120 days, $2,708–$3,800), health permit to operate (14–45 days, $470–$1,000), and building permit with change of use (14–120 days, $800–$15,000). The timeline assumes the CUA is filed after the SUD license-transfer question is settled in writing, the ABC Type 42 application or transfer is filed after the CUA is approved and the 30-day appeal period has run, the POE permit is filed in parallel with or after the ABC application, and the building permit and health permit are filed after the CUA and POE approvals are in hand. The 255–635 day range is measured from filing the CUA to obtaining the health permit and building permit final sign-off, assuming all approvals are granted.
